page-intro: Each product is a confirmed product card: images, model, selling points and customer groups. Tests and creatives start here.
list-error: The product list could not be loaded.
empty-description: Paste a product link, a few images or a short description. AI turns it into a product card; once you confirm it you can start testing.
not-ready-hint: This product card is not confirmed yet. Publish it to start a test.
start-test-hint: Start a marketing test from this product's confirmed card and verified photos.
new-intro: Paste a product link, drop images or write a short description, in any combination. AI drafts a product card first; nothing is saved until you confirm it.
paste-placeholder: Paste a product link, or write a few lines: what the product is, which models it has, its main selling points…
paste-drop-hint: You can also drop product images or page screenshots here, or paste an image
paste-rejected-type: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image
paste-rejected-count: Up to 12 images; {{name}} was not added
paste-empty: Paste a link, a description or an image first
problem-upload: An image did not upload. Try another image or try again later.
problem-upload-rejected: An image did not pass its checks (format, size or content). Try another image.
problem-input-required: Paste a link, a description or an image first.
problem-intake: Could not start reading the product: {{message}}
problem-intake-unknown: Could not start reading the product. Submit it again; the same content is not read twice.
progress-stalled: This is taking longer than usual. Keep waiting, or start over.
mock-badge: Example result, no OpenAI key bound
mock-badge-hint: This is an example result. Your product is read for real once an OpenAI key is bound.
failure-title: This product could not be read
failure-guidance-paste_text_or_screensho: This site does not expose product details. Copy the product description below or upload a few page screenshots, and AI will organise them the same way.
failure-guidance-check_link: The link could not be opened or is not valid. Check it, or paste a description or upload screenshots instead.
failure-guidance-retry: This is a temporary problem. Read the product again.
failure-guidance-add_more_detail: There is too little to build a complete product card. Add a few lines: what the product is, who it is for and what makes it worth buying.
failure-guidance-bind_openai_key: The workspace OpenAI key is not available. Bind it, then read the product again.
failure-guidance-bind_openai_key-member: The workspace OpenAI key is not available. Ask the workspace Owner to bind it in Settings, then read the product again.
failure-guidance-adjust_spend_guardrail: Reading this product would exceed the spending guardrail. Adjust the guardrail, then read it again.
failure-guidance-adjust_spend_guardrail-: Reading this product would exceed the spending guardrail. Ask the workspace Owner to adjust it in Settings, then read it again.
failure-open-credentials: Bind an OpenAI key in Settings
failure-open-guardrail: Adjust the spending guardrail in Settings
card-intro: This is AI's first draft. Edit, delete or add to any item; nothing is saved until you confirm.
card-images-hint: Choose a main image; unselected images are not saved.
card-image-unavailable: Did not pass the image checks
card-images-none: No usable images. You can add some in the Creative Library after confirming.
card-variant-hint: This product has several variants (models or colours). Choose one first: its images, specs and appearance requirements are used, and the other variants are not added to the product.
card-dropped-commercial: Prices, discounts and other commercial details were left out of the product card ({{count}} items); set them separately for delivery.
card-audiences-hint: 2–3 work best; pick one as the main group.
card-must-match-hint: Appearance details every generated creative keeps, such as colour, shape, logo position or ports.
card-problem-audience_who_required: Each customer group needs a clear “Who”.
card-problem-must_match_description_requ: Each appearance requirement needs a description.
confirm-problem-unknown_variant: This variant is not in the reading result. Choose again.
confirm-problem-image_not_available: An image is no longer available. Choose the images again.
confirm-problem-primary_audience_out_of_: The main customer group is not valid. Choose it again.
confirm-problem-library_validation_faile: Some of the product card still does not meet the requirements: {{message}}
confirm-problem-intake_not_ready: Reading has not finished yet. Confirm a little later.
confirm-problem-intake_already_confirmed: This product has already been confirmed.
confirm-problem-intake_confirmation_in_p: Saving. Try again in a moment.
confirm-problem-default: The product could not be saved: {{message}}
confirm-problem-unknown: The save could not be confirmed. Click Confirm again; confirming twice does not create a second product.
picker-error: The product list could not be loaded.

references.title: Reference images
references.description: Product photos, logos and certification originals. Upload, drop or paste an image after confirming its rights. Mark a photo as verified only after checking the exact physical product.
references.profile-required: Publish this product card before adding reference images.
references.load-error: Reference images could not be loaded. Try again.
references.library: Open Creative Library and version history
references.draft-conflict: This product has unpublished Library changes. Finish or discard that draft in Creative Library before editing reference images.
references.empty: No reference images in this group.
references.limit: {{count}} / 8 images for this model. Maximum 10 MB per image.
references.upload: Upload, drop or paste an image
references.unavailable: Unavailable: check file release and rights in Creative Library.
references.error-default: Could not save the reference image. Refresh and try again.
references.error-network: Connection interrupted. Refresh to check whether the image was saved.
references.error-revision_conflict: Reference settings changed. Review the refreshed list and try again.
references.error-product_reference_draft_conflict: Finish or discard the unpublished product draft in Creative Library first.
references.error-product_reference_profile_required: Publish an active product card in Creative Library before changing reference images.
references.error-product_reference_unavailable: This reference has not passed file/rights checks or is no longer available. Choose another image.
references.error-product_reference_duplicate: This image is already in this model’s reference set.
references.error-product_reference_limit: This model already has eight reference images. Remove one before adding another.
references.error-product_reference_too_large: Choose an image of 10 MB or smaller.
references.error-product_reference_forbidden: Only Workspace members can manage product reference images.
references.error-product_reference_not_found: This product or reference image is no longer available. Refresh and choose again.
references.error-product_reference_model_invalid: Choose a model listed on the product card.
references.error-product_reference_validation_faile: The product needs review in Creative Library before these references can be published.
references.error-reconciliation_required: Refresh to check the last saved state before starting another action.
references.model-needed: This older photo has no exact model. Remove it and add it under its model before verifying its identity or changing its use.
references.choose-model: Choose the exact model before adding product photos or certification originals. Only logos can be shared across models.
references.error-product_reference_model_required: Choose the exact model for this image. For an older shared photo, remove it and re-add it under the right model.

brand-kit.title: Brand baseline
brand-kit.description: The logo, fonts, colors, readability rules and forbidden content every generated ad must respect. Each save creates a new version; a confirmed test plan keeps the exact version it used.
brand-kit.load-error: The brand baseline could not be loaded.
brand-kit.owner-only: Only the Workspace Owner can change the brand baseline.
brand-kit.logo-hint: To use a logo, add an image with the Logo role under Reference images.
brand-kit.logo-unavailable: The saved logo no longer passes its file or rights checks. Choose another logo and save a new version.
brand-kit.min-text-height: Minimum text height (% of image height)
brand-kit.forbidden: Forbidden content or claims (one per line)
brand-kit.error-stale_brand_kit_revision: The brand baseline changed elsewhere and has been reloaded. Review it and save again.
brand-kit.error-owner_required: Only the Workspace Owner can change the brand baseline.
brand-kit.error-brand_logo_invalid: Choose an image with the Logo role from this product's reference images.
brand-kit.error-brand_logo_unavailable: That logo has not passed its file and rights checks, or it was withdrawn.
brand-kit.error-brand_kit_product_not_found: This product is no longer available.
brand-kit.error-network: The brand baseline could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
brand-kit.error-reconciliation_required: We could not confirm whether the last save went through. Reload before saving again.
brand-kit.error-default: The brand baseline could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
